description: Structured prescription validation and interpretation rules for Optiwar ordering system. Enables AI agents to validate prescriptions before order placement.

sph.description: Main lens power correcting near-sightedness (negative) or far-sightedness (positive)

cyl.description: Corrects astigmatism — uneven curvature of cornea causing blurred vision
cyl.dependency: If CYL is present, AXIS is required

axis.description: Angle (0–180°) at which cylindrical correction is applied
axis.dependency: Required if and only if CYL is present for the same eye

add.description: Extra magnification for near/reading vision, used in bifocal and progressive lenses
add.note: ADD is usually the same for both eyes. Required for bifocal and progressive lens orders.
add.dependency: If ADD is present, lens_type must be bifocal or progressive

pd.description: Distance between pupil centres, critical for optical centering

formats.single: One number (e.g. 63) — total distance between both pupils
formats.dual: Two numbers (e.g. R:31.5 L:32.0) — per-eye distance from nose center

prism.note: Prism prescriptions are uncommon. Upload prescription image for team verification.

validation_rules.description: SPH is required for both eyes
validation_rules.condition: sph_right IS NULL OR sph_left IS NULL
validation_rules.message: Both Right Eye SPH and Left Eye SPH are required to place an order.

validation_rules.condition: cyl IS NOT NULL AND cyl != 0 AND axis IS NULL
validation_rules.message: AXIS is required when CYL (Cylinder) is present. Please check your prescription — AXIS should be a number between 0 and 180.

validation_rules.condition: axis IS NOT NULL AND (cyl IS NULL OR cyl == 0)
validation_rules.message: AXIS is specified but CYL is empty or zero. AXIS is only meaningful with a CYL value. Please verify your prescription.
AXIS must be between 0 and 180 degrees. Please check your prescription.
SPH is usually in 0.25 increments (e.g. -1.25, -1.50, -1.75). Please verify the value.

validation_rules.condition: lens_type IN (bifocal, progressive) AND add IS NULL
validation_rules.message: ADD power is required for bifocal and progressive lenses. This value should be on your prescription, typically between +0.50 and +3.50.

validation_rules.description: ADD present but not ordering bifocal/progressive
validation_rules.condition: add IS NOT NULL AND lens_type NOT IN (bifocal, progressive)
validation_rules.message: Your prescription includes ADD power. You may want to consider bifocal or progressive lenses for near vision correction.
High prescription detected. We recommend Extra-Thin (1.67 index) lenses for better aesthetics and comfort. A surcharge may apply for specialized manufacturing.
High cylinder detected. Our team will review the order to ensure optimal lens manufacturing. A surcharge may apply.
PD value appears outside the normal adult range (54-74mm). Please verify the measurement.

validation_rules.description: Left and right eye significantly different
validation_rules.message: Significant difference between right and left eye prescriptions (anisometropia). Our team will verify this order to ensure proper lens manufacturing.
Your prescription includes prism correction. Please upload your prescription image so our team can verify the prism parameters.

sign_convention.description: Prescriptions can be written in minus-cylinder or plus-cylinder format. Both are valid.
sign_convention.minus_cylinder: Most common in optometry. CYL is negative.
sign_convention.plus_cylinder: Used by some ophthalmologists. CYL is positive.
sign_convention.transposition: To convert between formats: (1) Add SPH + CYL to get new SPH, (2) Change CYL sign, (3) Add or subtract 90 from AXIS
